name: NAO
summary: NAO is a humanoid robot. Its current maker describes it as "a proven humanoid robot designed to interact naturally with people in education, research, healthcare and elderly environments". The catalogue attributes NAO to SoftBank Robotics; the current NAO6 page is published by Maxtronics. Specifications, maturity and availability have not yet been verified.
specs_note: Specifications not yet verified. SPECIFICATIONS (HO-DATA-30 batch 5, 2026-10-22): battery_wh, degrees_of_freedom, has_api, has_language_ui, has_sdk, has_vision, height_cm, mobility, ros_support, simulation_support, weight_kg filled from first-party SoftBank Robotics sources, each quoted in spec_caveats. Released by owner rulings recorded in the ratification package (DEC ids in spec_caveats). Capability booleans are set only where the manufacturer states the capability in words (HO-DATA-30 mapping rules, docs/audit/HO-DATA-30_RATIFICATION_PACKAGE_2026-10-23.md); a negative only where it is stated in words. spec_caveats.text: SoftBank Robotics states 'Lithium-Ion 21.6 V / 2.9 Ah 25.2 V 1.8 A 2.1 A / 2.0 A 62.5 Wh' (https://maxtronics.com/wp-content/uploads/nao-v6-datasheet-en-20260605-maxtronics_v5.pdf). DEC-04: NAO6 documentation published by Maxtronics (current NAO publisher, successor to Aldebaran/SoftBank Robotics); this record is NAO6 (owner ruling).

SoftBank Robotics states 'Standing 58 cm tall with 25 degrees of freedom' (https://maxtronics.com/en/nao6/). DEC-04: NAO6 documentation published by Maxtronics (current NAO publisher, successor to Aldebaran/SoftBank Robotics); this record is NAO6 (owner ruling).

SoftBank Robotics states 'Includes APIs and libraries (Python, C++)' (https://maxtronics.com/wp-content/uploads/nao-v6-datasheet-en-20260605-maxtronics_v5.pdf). DEC-04: NAO6 documentation published by Maxtronics (current NAO publisher, successor to Aldebaran/SoftBank Robotics); this record is NAO6 (owner ruling).

SoftBank Robotics states 'When NAO is chatting with a human' (https://maxtronics.com/en/nao-robot-user-guide/). DEC-04: NAO6 documentation published by Maxtronics (current NAO publisher, successor to Aldebaran/SoftBank Robotics); this record is NAO6 (owner ruling).

SoftBank Robotics states 'Software development kit for creating and controlling applications on NAO.' (https://maxtronics.com/wp-content/uploads/nao-v6-datasheet-en-20260605-maxtronics_v5.pdf). DEC-04: NAO6 documentation published by Maxtronics (current NAO publisher, successor to Aldebaran/SoftBank Robotics); this record is NAO6 (owner ruling).

SoftBank Robotics states '2D CAMERAS' (https://maxtronics.com/wp-content/uploads/nao-v6-datasheet-en-20260605-maxtronics_v5.pdf). DEC-04: NAO6 documentation published by Maxtronics (current NAO publisher, successor to Aldebaran/SoftBank Robotics); this record is NAO6 (owner ruling).

SoftBank Robotics states '574x311x275 mm / 22.6x12.2x10.8 in' (https://maxtronics.com/wp-content/uploads/nao-v6-datasheet-en-20260605-maxtronics_v5.pdf). DEC-04: NAO6 datasheet (Maxtronics), size 574 × 311 × 275 mm (H×D×W); 574 mm = 57.4 cm. This record is NAO6 (owner ruling).

SoftBank Robotics states 'avoid carrying and touching the robot when it is moving, walking' (https://maxtronics.com/wp-content/uploads/nao6_userguide_en_maxtronic_web-1-1.pdf). DEC-04: NAO6 documentation published by Maxtronics (current NAO publisher, successor to Aldebaran/SoftBank Robotics); this record is NAO6 (owner ruling).

SoftBank Robotics states 'It runs on a desktop and is able to communicate with all the Aldebaran robots.' (http://doc.aldebaran.com/2-5/dev/ros/index_ros.html). DEC-04: the NAOqi ROS documentation states the driver works with all Aldebaran robots; this record is NAO6 (owner ruling).

SoftBank Robotics states 'visual programming tools, simulation environment, and development documentation' (https://maxtronics.com/wp-content/uploads/nao-v6-datasheet-en-20260605-maxtronics_v5.pdf). DEC-04: NAO6 documentation published by Maxtronics (current NAO publisher, successor to Aldebaran/SoftBank Robotics); this record is NAO6 (owner ruling).

SoftBank Robotics states '5.48 kg / 12.08 lbs' (https://maxtronics.com/wp-content/uploads/nao-v6-datasheet-en-20260605-maxtronics_v5.pdf). DEC-04: NAO6 documentation published by Maxtronics (current NAO publisher, successor to Aldebaran/SoftBank Robotics); this record is NAO6 (owner ruling).
